title: fix: no-cache static headers (module-cache white screen), windowsHide all detached spawns, config edit UI
why:
- serveStatic sends Cache-Control: no-cache — stale shell.mjs in the browser
  module map broke imports and blanked the whole shell; local revalidation
  is millisecond-cheap and ends the class of bug
- every detached spawn (hook finalize, server finalize/ticker, runner
  finalize, serve start) now passes windowsHide — no more console windows
  popping on Windows after each commit
- POST /api/sync/config + console editor (debounce/schedule/max_pages,
  validated 0-1440/HH:MM/1-50, partial merge keeps mode) — auto cadence
  is now controllable from the page, on/off was already the mode switch

title: fix(server): 301 trailing-slash redirect on directory requests (white-screen root cause)
why:
User hit http://127.0.0.1:7001/site (no trailing slash): serveStatic served
index.html at that URL, so the browser resolved ./shell.mjs against the
parent → GET /shell.mjs → 404 → module never executed → blank shell.
python http.server redirects; ours now does too (301, portal keeps its
/<repo> prefix). Pinned for both server flavors.

title: feat(portal): in-shell repo switcher + home button
why:
GET /repos.json (read-only list, zero-write invariant intact); shell detects
portal form (BASE != '/') and injects a home link + repo <select> next to
the brand — jump between repo wikis without retyping URLs. Verified live:
lore <-> threat-intel both ways, per-repo serve unaffected (404 -> no UI).

title: feat(shell): repo switcher on per-repo serve too — jumps via portal
why:
Per-repo server now serves /repos.json (central registry + portal port +
current repo, path-injectable for tests); the shell renders the same home
button + switcher in both forms, targeting absolute portal URLs from
per-repo pages. Verified live: 7001 dropdown -> 7842/threat-intel/site/.

title: fix(portal): repo-list page follows shell theme (shared CSS vars + same localStorage key, with its own switcher)
fix: windowsHide on every execFileSync — git.exe spawned its own console inside hidden detached processes
why:
The detached node windows were already hidden, but git/taskkill/python
children re-created visible consoles (execFileSync defaults windowsHide
to false when the parent has no console). All 11 call sites covered.

title: feat(portal): route /api per repo + take over auto ticker — console fully operational behind portal
why:
v0.6 'portal read-only' flipped by user need: all local APIs extracted into
shared handleApi(root,...) (sendJson returns true as the handled signal);
portal strips /<name> and forwards with the same localHost guard, writes
stay scoped to that repo's .state. tickAuto(loreDir) extracted (never
throws); per-repo CLI uses it and portal __run loops every registered repo
(registry re-read each tick). Old read-only 404 assertions flipped with the
design. Verified live: queue/finalize/mode all operational on 7842.
